The key component is the `s3presign` runner.

Checking runner.go for the schedule and server.go for the wiring site.

The `s3presign` runner in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` handles this.

It refreshes presigned S3 URLs for externally-stored attachments. It runs every 12 hours and once immediately at startup. It refreshes URLs within 4 days of expiration. It is wired into `Server.Start()` in `server/server.go` at line 129 via `startBackgroundRunners`. The runner setup is in `startBackgroundRunners` at lines 153–174.

Checking whether other storage types, such as EXTERNAL, also have background runners that refresh attachment URLs.

The s3presign runner refreshes presigned S3 URLs to prevent externally-stored attachment links from going stale.

It runs every 12 hours via a ticker in Run(), plus once at startup. Server.Start() calls startBackgroundRunners(ctx) at line 129. The runner is created inside startBackgroundRunners starting at line 153.

Reconsidering whether line 161 is the more precise wiring site. Checking cmd/memos/main.go to verify the full startup chain.

The s3presign runner is the component that prevents external attachment links from going stale.

It refreshes S3 presigned URLs in attachment.Reference. It runs every 12 hours via runnerInterval. It also executes once immediately at startup before the continuous loop begins. It is wired into Server.Start() through startBackgroundRunners() at line 129.

The s3presign runner is the component that prevents externally-stored attachment links from going stale.

It runs every 12 hours plus an immediate RunOnce at startup. It is wired into server startup in server/server.go at line 129, via startBackgroundRunners called from Start(). The runner itself is instantiated at lines 161–163.

h01.

**s3presign runner** — **every 12 hours** (plus one immediate run at startup via `RunOnce`) — **server/server.go:129**

The `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` keeps S3 attachment links fresh by re-presigning URLs whose `LastPresignedTime` is within 4 days of expiry (presigned URLs expire after 5 days; see `internal/storage/s3/s3.go:77-79`). It lists S3 attachments in batches and updates each `Reference` with a new presigned URL.

The schedule is defined as `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`, and `Run()` ticks on that interval (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:29-40`).

Startup wiring is in `Server.startBackgroundRunners()` (`server/server.go:153-174`): it creates the runner, calls `RunOnce(ctx)` immediately (`server/server.go:163`), then starts `Run(s3Context)` in a background goroutine (`server/server.go:167-169`). That method is invoked from `Server.Start()` at `server/server.go:129`.
